experiments.scope: Selected target sha3-256-r6. For each organizer seed the program expands 512 bit-plane words with SHAKE-256, runs the exact 70,772-instruction bitsliced register program that the ledger charges, and keys 256 64-byte messages at once. It returns two distinct messages whose bitsliced keys agree on 8 digest bits spread over all four output lanes (bits 0 and 7 of digest bytes 0, 8, 16, 24). With more than 512 trials, batches are reused for further pairs. Trial 0 also reports the program's instruction counts and a full 256-message comparison with an independent scalar reference.
experiments.hypothesis: The straight-line bitsliced program computes sha3-256-r6 of every message in its batch exactly, so pairs selected using only its output keys satisfy the masked digest equality when the organizer hashes them with the official function.
